# pvecli vm remove

Delete one or more VMs.

```text
pvecli vm remove [VMIDS] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMIDS` | VM ID(s) - single, comma-separated, or range (e.g., 100, 100,101, 100-105). |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `--purge` | Remove from backup/HA config. |
| `-f`, `--force` | Force stop VM before deletion. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
